description: Families witnessing the definitions of p, a and u exist; an infinite maximal almost disjoint witness has size continuum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.witnesses_exist :
  (∃ F, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsPseudointersectionObstruction F) ∧
    (∃ A, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsInfiniteMAD A ∧ Cardinal.mk ↑A = Cardinal.continuum) ∧
      ∃ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsFreeUltrafilterBase B
